### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                                                                |
| ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| ~     | *n.*   | bond, sticking, attachment / glue, adhesive /<br>viscous fluid, semi-solid substance: mud, honey, etc. |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to stick, adhere, cling, attach (in/tr.)                                                               |
| ~a    | *psv.* | adhesive, sticky, clingy, viscous                                                                      |
| ~an   | *adj.* | bound, stuck, glued, attached                                                                          |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
泥 — two earth particles bound by a fluid -> mud, sticky
#### Sound
- Japanese "betabeta"
- *a priori:* b=weight, y=sticky, e=connective
